headline: Samsung's Z Fold 8 Ultra is more of the same, but better than ever
summary: Samsung launches the Z Fold 8 Ultra, a new flagship foldable. It features a distinct thin outer screen and square inner panel. This 'Ultra' model offers subtle refinements over previous Folds.

headline: Werewolf transformed my old gadgets into USB-C powered ones
summary: "Werewolf" is a new gadget that brings USB-C power to old electronics. It allows powering legacy devices like monitors or SNES consoles via USB batteries. This eliminates the need for original AC adapters.

headline: The best classic slasher movie you'll never watch
summary: This article explores a fictional yet iconic horror franchise, "Camp Miasma" (1980). It details its numerous sequels, arcade games, and extensive merchandise. A deep dive into a slasher classic that never truly existed.

headline: Why does Apple keep banning Telegram, but never X?
summary: Telegram briefly vanished from the Apple App Store this week. The article questions Apple's inconsistent enforcement against major apps. It highlights Telegram's role for over a billion users globally.

headline: Take-Two Boss Defends No Disc Version of GTA 6, Equates Physical Releases to Vinyl Records
summary: Take-Two's Strauss Zelnick defends GTA 6's digital-only release. He argues physical discs are largely obsolete for major game consumers. Zelnick compares physical games to niche vinyl records.

headline: Jim Lee's Iconic X-Men Art Shines in Marvel Artist Archive Hardcover
summary: A new "Marvel Artist Archive" hardcover celebrates Jim Lee's X-Men art. Get an exclusive look inside the massive collection. It highlights Lee's iconic 1990s contributions to the X-Men universe.

headline: Amazon Knocks $10 off Physical Nintendo Switch Sports Resort Preorders
summary: Amazon is offering a $10 discount on Nintendo Switch Sports Resort preorders. This deal matches the digital pricing for the physical version. The game is slated for an October release this year.

headline: LEGO Harry Potter Celebrates 25 Years With Ministry of Magic Set, and The First-Ever Minifigure of a Specific Character
summary: LEGO Harry Potter marks 25 years with a new Ministry of Magic set. The set introduces the first-ever Arabella Figg Minifigure. This release is a major celebration for fans of the magical theme.

headline: Serial sex offender guilty of murdering two women and raping third
summary: Serial sex offender Simon Levy has been found guilty. He murdered two women and raped a third. Levy was under police monitoring at the time of his crimes.

headline: How police let a registered sex offender murder and attack women
summary: A Met officer admits a second murder victim, Sheryl Wilkins, could have been saved. The article details systemic failures in police monitoring of Simon Levy. It raises serious questions about police accountability.

headline: Cambridge to review process for hiring senior academics after Jason Arday resignation
summary: Cambridge University is launching a review of its senior academic hiring. This follows the high-profile resignation of Professor Jason Arday. Critics are concerned about the university's self-review process.

headline: Seven killed after teen shooter opens fire at home and school in Thailand
summary: A tragic shooting in Thailand claims seven lives. A teenage gunman killed his grandparents at home. He then attacked his school, killing five teachers.
